youtube.title: Abraham Lincoln was a wrestling champ. 300 matches, 1 loss 🤼 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Abraham Lincoln was a legit wrestling champion before he was president. 🤼

Team Abe or Team Jack? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: in 1831 in New Salem, Illinois, Lincoln's boss bragged he could beat anyone, so local tough guy Jack Armstrong challenged him. Lincoln held his own, Armstrong's gang became his biggest supporters when he ran for the legislature, and he's credited with ~300 matches and 1 loss. He's in the National Wrestling Hall of Fame.
